audit.why: Even/skill matchup with no mobility on either side is accurately captured as a poke-and-trade lane.
Level 2 Q double-point spike and level 6 R spike are real and correctly timed against a dashless enemy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page repeatedly names Hwei's hard-CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)'. That name does not exist in Hwei's kit. His CC spell-set is E, called Subject: Torment, which repaints into Grim Visage / Gaze of the Abyss / Crushing Maw (cd 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s).
audit.why: A fabricated ability name shipped to a paying user is exactly the Brand 'Ares of Blaze' failure mode from the calibration notes — the reader will search for an ability that isn't there.
audit.corrected: Replaced every instance of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)' across enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t and report[9].t.
sources: enemyKit E text: 'Hwei envisions a series of torments... crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw'

edits.before: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Fear (CC Paints), denying your pattern, and out-chipping the 2v2 until your windows close.
edits.after: Hwei wins by landing Subject: Torment (E), denying your pattern, and out-chipping the 2v2 until your windows close.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz vs Hwei - Track: Hwei Subject: Torment (E). - Hold the root for the window that matters — one binding decides bot. - Engage only on Subject: Torment (E)'s cooldown. - Spend your ultimate on fight windows only.

edits.before: - Hwei Subject: Fear (CC Paints): matchup-defining — All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Tectonic Disruption answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Hwei Subject: Torment (E), 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD: matchup-defining — all his CC lives there, dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E is down 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s too — punish that window. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: His Q disasters are slow skillshots with no dash — juke the cast and punish with a bolt.

edits.before: Hwei wastes Subject: Fear (CC Paints) — that is your full-commit window.
edits.after: Hwei wastes Subject: Torment (E) — that is your full-commit window.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: His R expands from the first champion it hits — stack up and one cast slows your duo.

edits.before: Track Hwei’s Subject: Fear (CC Paints): All his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Hwei's Subject: Torment (E): all his CC lives on E — dodge the paint and the burst never chains. Forward steps wait for its downtime.

edits.before: Commit on Subject: Fear (CC Paints)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Subject: Torment (E)'s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry's damage online. Make him flinch first.
